source(output(
		NY_PA_STAGING_PyID as string,
		NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE as date,
		MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		MARKET as string,
		CALLLIST_CD as string,
		MEMBER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER as date,
		TOTAL_CALLS_MADE as integer,
		MEMBER_CALL_1_DATE as date,
		MEMBER_CALL_1_RESULT as string,
		MEMBER_CALL_2_DATE as date,
		MEMBER_CALL_2_RESULT as string,
		MEMBER_CALL_3_DATE as date,
		MEMBER_CALL_3_RESULT as string,
		MEMBER_CALL_4_DATE as date,
		MEMBER_CALL_4_RESULT as string,
		MEMBER_CALL_5_DATE as date,
		MEMBER_CALL_5_RESULT as string,
		SCRUB_DATE as date,
		SCRUB_RESULT as string,
		HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST as string,
		DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME as string,
		DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME as string,
		DESIGNEE_CALL as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @P_STARTDATE DATETIME ,@P_ENDDATE DATETIME ,@STARTDATE DATETIME ,@ENDDATE DATETIME  SET @P_STARTDATE = ? SET @P_ENDDATE = ?   IF @P_ENDDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @ENDDATE = CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) ELSE 	SET @ENDDATE = @P_ENDDATE  IF @P_STARTDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @STARTDATE = DATEADD(DAY, CASE  				WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, @ENDDATE) = 2 					THEN - 3 				ELSE - 1 				END, @ENDDATE) ELSE 	SET @STARTDATE = @P_STARTDATE;  DECLARE @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY TABLE ( NY_PA_STAGING_PyID VARCHAR(20),NY_PA_IID BIGINT)  INSERT INTO @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY  	SELECT DISTINCT NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID,NPS.NY_PA_IID 		FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID 		AND CL.CALLLIST_CD IN (\'331\', \'332\', \'333\',\'531\',\'532\',\'533\') 		AND CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE BETWEEN @STARTDATE 			AND @ENDDATE  	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID 			AND ( 			CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID NOT IN (3) 			OR CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID = 0) 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_EXTRADATA_IID = M.MEMBER_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_2008.DBO.PDS_NY_PA_STAGING NPS ON NPS.NY_PA_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE ICR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTGROUPRULE IGR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID = IGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID 		WHERE CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ACTIVE_IND = 0 		AND ICR.CALLLISTRULE_CD <> \'HEADOFHOUSEHOLD\'   DECLARE @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY_CALLS TABLE ( NY_PA_IID BIGINT, 									NY_PA_STAGING_PyID VARCHAR(20), 									NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE  Date, 									MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER  VARCHAR(30), 									MEMBER_FIRST_NAME VARCHAR(35), 									MEMBER_LAST_NAME VARCHAR(35), 									MARKET VARCHAR(30), 									CALLLIST_CD VARCHAR(10), 									MEMBER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER DATE, 									SCRUB_DATE DATE, 									SCRUB_RULE_DESC VARCHAR(50), 									HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST VARCHAR(50) , 									CALL_SEQ BIGINT, 									TOTAL_CALLS_MADE INT, 									SCRUB_FLG CHAR(1), 									DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME Varchar(50), 									DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME Varchar(50), 									DESIGNEE_CALL Varchar(10) )  INSERT INTO @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY_CALLS  SELECT   	NPS.NY_PA_IID 	,NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID 	 		,CAST(NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE AS DATE) AS CLOSE_DATE 		,M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER 		,M.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME 		,M.MEMBER_LAST_NAME 		,M.MEMBER_MCAID_PLAN_CD AS MARKET 		,CAST(CL.CALLLIST_CD AS VARCHAR(4)) AS CALLLIST_CD 		,[CALLLISTSTATUS_LISTINITIALLOAD_DT] AS MEMBER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER 		,CONVERT(DATE, CASE  				WHEN DATEPART(HOUR, CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) > 20 					THEN DATEADD(DAY, 1, CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) 				ELSE CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE 				END) AS SCRUB_DATE 		,COALESCE(DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION,ICR.CALLLISTRULE_DESC, IGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_DESC) AS SCRUB_RULE_DESC 		,ACL.CALLLIST_NAME AS HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST 		,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID,NPS.NY_PA_IID ORDER BY CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) AS CALL_SEQ 	,COUNT(1) OVER(PARTITION BY NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID,NPS.NY_PA_IID)-1 AS TOTAL_CALLS_MADE 	, CASE WHEN DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION IS NULL THEN \'Y\' ELSE \'N\' END SCRUB_FLG 	,NPS.DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME AS DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME 	,NPS.DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME AS DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME 	,\'N\' AS DESIGNEE_CALL 	FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID 		AND CL.CALLLIST_CD IN (\'331\', \'332\', \'333\',\'531\',\'532\',\'533\') 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_EXTRADATA_IID = M.MEMBER_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_2008.DBO.PDS_NY_PA_STAGING NPS ON NPS.NY_PA_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID 	INNER JOIN @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY  SCY ON SCY.NY_PA_IID=NPS.NY_PA_IID  	LEFT JOIN  [PDS_2008].[dbo].[PDS_CALLLISTSTATUS] CS 		ON CM.[CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID] = [CALLLISTSTATUS_ENTITY_IID] 		AND CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_CALLLIST_IID = CL.CALLLIST_IID  	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE ICR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTGROUPRULE IGR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID = IGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID    	/* SNOW-49513 - NY44 Scrub rule File changes to include history*/ 	LEFT JOIN PDS_CALL C ON C.CALL_CALLLISTMASTER_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID 	LEFT JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DC ON C.CALL_DISPOSITIONCODE_IID = DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID 	LEFT JOIN ( 		SELECT CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID 			,CL.CALLLIST_CD 			,CL.CallLIST_NAME 			,CLD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE 		FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL 		INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CLD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CLD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID 		INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CLM ON CLM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CLD.CALLLISTDATE_IID 			AND CL.CALLLISTGROUP_IID = 1 			AND CALLLISTMASTER_ACTIVE_IND = 1 		) ACL ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = ACL.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID 		AND CAST(ACL.CALLLISTDATE_DATE AS DATE) = CAST(CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE AS DATE) 		AND CL.CALLLIST_CD <> ACL.CALLLIST_CD 		AND CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID IS NOT NULL  WHERE COALESCE(DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION,ICR.CALLLISTRULE_DESC, IGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_DESC) <> \'Bad phone\' AND COALESCE(DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION,ICR.CALLLISTRULE_DESC, IGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_DESC) <> \'Head of Household\' AND NPS.NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE < CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE   DECLARE @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY_CALLS_DATE TABLE (NY_PA_IID BIGINT, 									NY_PA_STAGING_PyID VARCHAR(20), 									NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE  Date, 									MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER  VARCHAR(30), 									MEMBER_FIRST_NAME VARCHAR(35), 									MEMBER_LAST_NAME VARCHAR(35), 									MARKET VARCHAR(30), 									CALLLIST_CD VARCHAR(10), 									HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST VARCHAR(50) , 									MEMBER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER DATE, 									TOTAL_CALLS_MADE INT, 									DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME Varchar(50), 									DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME Varchar(50), 									DESIGNEE_CALL Varchar(10),  									MEMBER_CALL_1_DATE DATE, 									MEMBER_CALL_2_DATE DATE, 									MEMBER_CALL_3_DATE DATE, 									MEMBER_CALL_4_DATE DATE, 									MEMBER_CALL_5_DATE DATE, 									SCRUB_DATE DATE)  Insert into @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY_CALLS_DATE SELECT  	DT.NY_PA_IID,DT.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID,	DT.NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE,	DT.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER,	DT.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME,DT.MEMBER_LAST_NAME,	DT.MARKET,	DT.CALLLIST_CD,  	DT.HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST,DT.MEMBER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER, DT.TOTAL_CALLS_MADE,DT.DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME,DT.DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME,DT.DESIGNEE_CALL 	,[1] MEMBER_CALL_1_DATE																											  	,[2] MEMBER_CALL_2_DATE 	,[3] MEMBER_CALL_3_DATE 	,[4] MEMBER_CALL_4_DATE 	,[5] MEMBER_CALL_5_DATE 	,SQ.MX_SD FROM (	 	SELECT  		NY_PA_IID 		,	NY_PA_STAGING_PyID 		,	NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE 		,	MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER 		,	MEMBER_FIRST_NAME 		,	MEMBER_LAST_NAME 		,	MARKET 		,	CALLLIST_CD 		,   MEMBER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER 		,  SCRUB_DATE 				,	HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST 		,TOTAL_CALLS_MADE 		,DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME 		,DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME 		,DESIGNEE_CALL 		,CALL_SEQ  	FROM @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY_CALLS  	WHERE SCRUB_FLG=\'N\' 		AND CASE WHEN SCRUB_FLG=\'Y\' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END<=5 	 )A PIVOT( MAX(SCRUB_DATE) FOR CALL_SEQ IN ([1], [2], [3], [4],[5]) ) AS DT  INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT NY_PA_IID, MAX(SCRUB_DATE) OVER(PARTITION BY NY_PA_IID)  AS MX_SD FROM @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY_CALLS ) SQ 	ON DT.NY_PA_IID = SQ.NY_PA_IID  UNION  SELECT  	DT.NY_PA_IID,DT.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID,	DT.NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE,	DT.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER,	DT.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME,DT.MEMBER_LAST_NAME,	DT.MARKET,	DT.CALLLIST_CD, 	DT.HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST,DT.MEMBER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER, DT.TOTAL_CALLS_MADE,DT.DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME,DT.DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME,DT.DESIGNEE_CALL 	,[2] MEMBER_CALL_1_DATE 	,[3] MEMBER_CALL_2_DATE 	,[4] MEMBER_CALL_3_DATE 	,[5] MEMBER_CALL_4_DATE 	,[6] MEMBER_CALL_5_DATE 	,SQ.MX_SD FROM (	 	SELECT  		NY_PA_IID 		,	NY_PA_STAGING_PyID 		,	NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE 		,	MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER 		,	MEMBER_FIRST_NAME 		,	MEMBER_LAST_NAME 		,	MARKET 		,	CALLLIST_CD 		,   MEMBER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER 		,   SCRUB_DATE 						,	HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST 		,TOTAL_CALLS_MADE 		,DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME 		,DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME 		,DESIGNEE_CALL 		,CALL_SEQ  	FROM @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY_CALLS  	WHERE SCRUB_FLG=\'Y\' 	AND TOTAL_CALLS_MADE = 0 		AND CASE WHEN SCRUB_FLG=\'N\' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END<=5  		  )A PIVOT( MAX(SCRUB_DATE) FOR CALL_SEQ IN ([2], [3], [4], [5],[6]) ) AS DT  INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT NY_PA_IID, MAX(SCRUB_DATE) OVER(PARTITION BY NY_PA_IID)  AS MX_SD FROM @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY_CALLS ) SQ 	ON DT.NY_PA_IID = SQ.NY_PA_IID  	 DECLARE @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY_CALLS_RESULT TABLE (NY_PA_IID BIGINT, 											MEMBER_CALL_1_RESULT VARCHAR(200), 											MEMBER_CALL_2_RESULT VARCHAR(200), 											MEMBER_CALL_3_RESULT VARCHAR(200), 											MEMBER_CALL_4_RESULT VARCHAR(200), 											MEMBER_CALL_5_RESULT VARCHAR(200), 											SCRUB_RESULT VARCHAR(200))   Insert into @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY_CALLS_RESULT SELECT DISTINCT  	 RES.NY_PA_IID	 	,[1] MEMBER_CALL_1_RESULT 	,[2] MEMBER_CALL_2_RESULT 	,[3] MEMBER_CALL_3_RESULT 	,[4] MEMBER_CALL_4_RESULT 	,[5] MEMBER_CALL_5_RESULT 	,SQ.SCRUB_RULE_DESC FROM (	 	SELECT  		SCRUB_RULE_DESC 		,NY_PA_IID 		,CALL_SEQ 	FROM @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY_CALLS WHERE SCRUB_FLG=\'N\' 		AND CASE WHEN SCRUB_FLG=\'Y\' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END <=5 )A PIVOT( MAX(SCRUB_RULE_DESC)  FOR CALL_SEQ IN ([1], [2], [3], [4],[5]) ) AS RES  INNER JOIN ( 	SELECT T1.NY_PA_IID 		, T1.SCRUB_RULE_DESC 	FROM @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY_CALLS T1 	WHERE T1.CALL_SEQ = ( 			SELECT MAX(T2.CALL_SEQ)  			FROM @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY_CALLS T2  			WHERE T2.NY_PA_STAGING_PYID = T1.NY_PA_STAGING_PYID) 		) SQ 	ON RES.NY_PA_IID = SQ.NY_PA_IID  UNION  SELECT DISTINCT  	 RES.NY_PA_IID	 	,[2] MEMBER_CALL_1_RESULT 	,[3] MEMBER_CALL_2_RESULT 	,[4] MEMBER_CALL_3_RESULT 	,[5] MEMBER_CALL_4_RESULT 	,[6] MEMBER_CALL_5_RESULT 	,SQ.SCRUB_RULE_DESC FROM (	 	SELECT  		SCRUB_RULE_DESC 		,NY_PA_IID 		,CALL_SEQ 	FROM @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY_CALLS  	WHERE SCRUB_FLG=\'Y\' 	AND TOTAL_CALLS_MADE = 0 		AND CASE WHEN SCRUB_FLG=\'N\' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END<=5 )A PIVOT( MAX(SCRUB_RULE_DESC)  FOR CALL_SEQ IN ([2], [3], [4], [5], [6]) ) AS RES  INNER JOIN ( 	SELECT T1.NY_PA_IID 		, T1.SCRUB_RULE_DESC 	FROM @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY_CALLS T1 	WHERE T1.CALL_SEQ = ( 			SELECT MAX(T2.CALL_SEQ)  			FROM @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY_CALLS T2  			WHERE T2.NY_PA_STAGING_PYID = T1.NY_PA_STAGING_PYID) 		) SQ 	ON RES.NY_PA_IID = SQ.NY_PA_IID  SELECT 	 D.NY_PA_STAGING_PyID 	,D.NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE 	,D.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER 	,D.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME 	,D.MEMBER_LAST_NAME 	,D.MARKET 	,D.CALLLIST_CD 	,D.MEMBER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER 	,D.HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST 	,D.TOTAL_CALLS_MADE  	,D.MEMBER_CALL_1_DATE 	,D.MEMBER_CALL_2_DATE 	,D.MEMBER_CALL_3_DATE 	,D.MEMBER_CALL_4_DATE 	,D.MEMBER_CALL_5_DATE 	,D.SCRUB_DATE 	,R.MEMBER_CALL_1_RESULT 	,R.MEMBER_CALL_2_RESULT 	,R.MEMBER_CALL_3_RESULT 	,R.MEMBER_CALL_4_RESULT 	,R.MEMBER_CALL_5_RESULT 	,R.SCRUB_RESULT 	,D.DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME 	,D.DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME 	,D.DESIGNEE_CALL 	 FROM @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY_CALLS_RESULT R FULL OUTER JOIN  @SCRUB_MEMBER_NY_CALLS_DATE D ON R.NY_PA_IID= D.NY_PA_IID ORDER BY D.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> PDSScrubbedCalls
PDSScrubbedCalls split(TextFilesExportInd == 1, disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(ExportTextFile,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
PDSScrubbedCalls derive({Copy of MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER} = MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER,
		{Copy of HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST} = HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST,
		{Copy of MEMBER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER} = MEMBER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER,
		{Copy of MEMBER_CALL_2_DATE} = MEMBER_CALL_2_DATE,
		{Copy of MEMBER_CALL_3_DATE} = MEMBER_CALL_3_DATE,
		{Copy of MEMBER_CALL_4_RESULT} = MEMBER_CALL_4_RESULT,
		{Copy of DESIGNEE_CALL} = DESIGNEE_CALL,
		{Copy of CALLLIST_CD} = CALLLIST_CD,
		{Copy of MEMBER_CALL_2_RESULT} = MEMBER_CALL_2_RESULT,
		{Copy of MEMBER_CALL_4_DATE} = MEMBER_CALL_4_DATE,
		{Copy of DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME} = DESIGNEE_FIRST_NAME,
		{Copy of MEMBER_CALL_1_DATE} = MEMBER_CALL_1_DATE,
		{Copy of MEMBER_CALL_5_RESULT} = MEMBER_CALL_5_RESULT,
		{Copy of NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE} = NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE,
		{Copy of NY_PA_STAGING_PyID} = NY_PA_STAGING_PyID,
		{Copy of MEMBER_FIRST_NAME} = MEMBER_FIRST_NAME,
		{Copy of MARKET} = MARKET,
		{Copy of MEMBER_CALL_5_DATE} = MEMBER_CALL_5_DATE,
		{Copy of TOTAL_CALLS_MADE} = TOTAL_CALLS_MADE,
		{Copy of MEMBER_LAST_NAME} = MEMBER_LAST_NAME,
		{Copy of SCRUB_RESULT} = SCRUB_RESULT,
		{Copy of DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME} = DESIGNEE_LAST_NAME,
		{Copy of MEMBER_CALL_1_RESULT} = MEMBER_CALL_1_RESULT,
		{Copy of SCRUB_DATE} = SCRUB_DATE,
		{Copy of MEMBER_CALL_3_RESULT} = MEMBER_CALL_3_RESULT) ~> DataConversion
ConditionalSplit@ExportTextFile sink(input(
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_CALL_1_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MARKET as string,
		NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST as string,
		NY_PA_STAGING_PyID as string,
		CALLLIST_CD as string,
		MEMBER_CALL_4_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_CALL_1_RESULT as string,
		MEMBER_CALL_2_RESULT as string,
		MEMBER_CALL_3_RESULT as string,
		MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		MEMBER_CALL_3_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MEMBER_CALL_2_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MEMBER_CALL_5_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MEMBER_CALL_5_RESULT as string,
		SCRUB_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MEMBER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MEMBER_CALL_4_RESULT as string,
		SCRUB_RESULT as string,
		TOTAL_CALLS_MADE as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME,
		MEMBER_CALL_1_DATE,
		MARKET,
		NY_PA_STAGING_CLOSE_DATE,
		HIGHER_PRIORITY_LIST,
		NY_PA_STAGING_PyID,
		CALLLIST_CD,
		MEMBER_CALL_4_DATE,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME,
		MEMBER_CALL_1_RESULT,
		MEMBER_CALL_2_RESULT,
		MEMBER_CALL_3_RESULT,
		MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER,
		MEMBER_CALL_3_DATE,
		MEMBER_CALL_2_DATE,
		MEMBER_CALL_5_DATE,
		MEMBER_CALL_5_RESULT,
		SCRUB_DATE,
		MEMBER_FIRST_DATE_ON_DIALER,
		MEMBER_CALL_4_RESULT,
		SCRUB_RESULT,
		TOTAL_CALLS_MADE)) ~> FlatFileDestination
